acceptance: 普通源码入口与Release解压入口默认导入预构建镜像，缺失时校验下载，无编译或基础镜像拉取回退。
按Docker引擎架构选择唯一清单行，验证归档SHA256、镜像ID、平台、源码和CAD运行时；失败不切换镜像或开始数据迁移。
真实Docker普通源码目录在没有Dockerfile或编译器时启动，迁移与数据内容权限保持；Windows静态与脚本回归，宿主由用户验收。
后续packaging自动生成/交付清单引用的完整镜像包及校验记录；最终主分支、离线包和远端附件分别验证，不能把本地准备等同上传成功。

requirements.summary: 用户明确这是所有设备的启动分发规则，不仅另一台Mac的临时处理；源码构建应为显式开发动作。

design.summary: 仓库携带每架构固定清单（非可执行数据）；先命中镜像/本地包，否则仅从本仓库HTTPS Release下载，逐层校验后按既有绑定/迁移启动。Release完整包沿用本地导入，无联网构建。

implementation.summary: POSIX and Windows default verified prebuilt import, architecture/source/CAD identity checks, explicit source build opt-in, deterministic legacy owner selection, and packaging-generated ARM64/AMD64 complete bundle index implemented.

verification.summary: 21 launcher/import and 4 installer tests; real isolated Docker migration/rollback and ordinary checkout without compiler; both complete archives checksum/license/identity/import verified. Actual start.command production and fresh ARM64 package startup passed; AMD64 CAD regression passed under emulation. Windows native is user-owned, receiving devices not claimed. Final exact-input full remains release gate.

documentation.summary: Installation and packaging documentation distinguish prebuilt defaults, explicit dev builds, complete archive identity, native acceptance limits, and local versus remote delivery.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed scoped changes and distribution metadata; private data excluded. Fresh fixture stopped and removed only its own containers/networks, prior slot tag restored; production runtime/data and historical release assets retained.

release_authorization: 用户要求源码仓库与Release包也必须具备完整运行镜像快速导入/启动能力；沿用先前main推送授权，允许上传本仓库发布附件。
rollback: 保留551eff及历史发布附件和私有数据；下载或身份校验失败不切换，旧目标镜像保留回滚标签；不删除用户容器或卷。
handoff: Both architecture packages verified/imported; fresh ARM64 start.command smoke passed; AMD64 geometry passed under emulation. Next: merge authorized scoped branch into local main, run final full with Node PATH, gate each scoped task, upload/verify complete Release assets, then push main and update delivery receipts. Do not claim remote or receiving-device success yet.
